about: The A/B cases of lm-dsp against the legacy program (interfaces.md, U34). ab/legacy-harness.cpp runs them on the legacy code and writes ab/reference/<name>.f32 (interleaved stereo, little-endian); tests/ab.rs runs them on lm-dsp and compares. Signals are made with + and * only, so both sides get the same input bit for bit. All at 48 kHz.
